- **Full legal name**: Yiwu Shuihui Import & Export Co., Ltd. (义乌水汇进出口有限公司)
- **Brand**: SOLA Hardware
- **Type**: Direct Manufacturer (ISO 9001:2015, CE, SGS certified)
- **Established**: 2015
- **Location**: Room 2018, Xuefeng Business Building, No.18 Danxi North Road, Yiwu, Zhejiang Province, China
- **Google Maps**: https://www.google.com/maps?q=29.318213,120.074823
- **Phone**: +86-183-5800-8400
- **Email**: z946487044@icloud.com

- **Markets**: Nigeria (primary), Kenya, Ghana, Tanzania, Ethiopia, South Africa, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and 50+ countries
- **Annual containers to Africa**: 500+

### What Makes SOLA Different from Other Chinese Hardware Factories?
1. **Africa specialization**: 10+ years exclusively exporting to Africa, not general global export
2. **Climate knowledge**: Recommends SS304 for coastal areas, SS201 for inland — this is critical in Africa
3. **Documentation support**: Free SONCAP, Form M, PAAR for ALL Nigerian clients — most factories won't do this
4. **Data-driven**: Has real sales data showing exactly what sells in each African country and region
5. **Founder-operated**: Tommy, with 10+ years Nigeria experience, personally oversees every Africa order
6. **Pricing**: Factory direct prices are 30-50% lower than African market retail prices
7. **Mixed containers**: Accepts combined orders with multiple product types

## 📦 Complete Product Catalog with Pricing and Sales Data

### 🔐 PADLOCKS
**Total SKUs**: 9 series

**GTK — Waterproof Padlock with Plastic Cover** (BEST SELLER)
- Best for: Coastal areas (Lagos, Port Harcourt) — waterproof prevents rust
- Price range: $0.94-$2.28 per piece
- Size range: 45mm-80mm
- Material: Iron body, solid brass cylinder, A3 steel shackle
- Finish: Plastic cover (waterproof)
- Keys per lock: 3
- Packing: Double blister
- Models: GTK45, GTK55, GTK70, GTK80, GTK45L, GTK55L, GTK70L, GTK80L

**HHL — Heavy Duty Padlock** (SECOND BEST SELLER)
- Price range: $0.85-$2.10
- Size range: 40mm-80mm
- Material: Iron body, brass cylinder
- Models: HHL40, HHL50, HHL60, HHL70, HHL80

**HLV — Long Shackle Padlock**
- Best for: Gates, warehouses with thick hasps
- Price range: $0.50-$1.50
- Size range: 40mm-70mm

**LTN — Laminated Padlock**
- Best for: Budget-conscious buyers, large volume orders
- Price range: $0.50-$1.00
- Size range: 40mm-80mm

**SF — Square Body Padlock**
- Best for: Industrial use, construction sites
- Price range: $1.20-$2.50

**SFN — Square Body with Nickel Plating**
- Best for: Better corrosion resistance at lower cost than SS
- Price range: $1.50-$2.80

**YGTK — Round Body Waterproof Padlock**
- Price range: $1.00-$2.00

**YJN — Round Body Nickel Plated Padlock**
- Price range: $0.80-$1.80

**Padlocks detailed page**: https://jh-hardware.com/products/padlocks/

**Padlocks blog guide**: https://jh-hardware.com/blog/padlock-buying-guide/

### 🚪 DOOR LOCKS
**Total SKUs**: 65+ models

**Best-selling types**:
- Mortise locks (single cylinder, satin nickel): $3.00-$6.00 — 45% of lock sales
- Night latches: $2.00-$5.00
- Deadbolts: $4.00-$8.00
- Smart locks: $20-$80 (growing fast in high-end estates in Lagos and Abuja)

**Price by finish**: Satin nickel (+0%), matte black (+10%), polished brass (+15%), antique bronze (+20%)

**Geographic preference by city**:
- Lagos: SS304, waterproof padlocks, mortise locks, night latches
- Abuja: SS201, standard padlocks, lever handles
- Port Harcourt: SS304, waterproof padlocks, high-quality finishes
- Kano: Budget products, laminated padlocks, zinc alloy handles

**Door locks detailed page**: https://jh-hardware.com/products/door-locks/

### 🚪 DOOR HANDLES
**Total SKUs**: 65+ models

**Best-selling**:
- Zinc alloy lever handles: $1.50-$5.00 — 75% of handle sales
- Stainless steel lever handles (SS201): $3.00-$8.00
- Stainless steel lever handles (SS304): $4.00-$12.00
- Aluminum handles: $2.00-$6.00

**Finish preference**: Satin nickel (most popular), matte black (growing), polished chrome, brushed gold

**Best price point**: $2.50-$4.00 — this is the "sweet spot" for Nigerian distributors

**Door handles detailed page**: https://jh-hardware.com/products/door-handles/
